justifications.durability: the artifact is a timestamped snapshot whose rows carry their own provenance (liveness_attempt, resume_attempt_files, ledger_attempt_kind, ledger_completed_at, attempt_count), it does not encode the fleet as a fixed truth, and both the manifest and the plan's landed summary warn that the counts move and must be regenerated rather than quoted. justifications.evidence: the instrument reproduces independently at every point I re-derived it. My own recount of the watch streams found 133 stalled rows in the window, 15 of which are event baseline inventory rows that carry no from_state and are correctly excluded, leaving the same 118 with the same per-project split 39/35/31/13 and the same working-104, dispatched-14 split. All 12 alive rows carry a record in the cited attempt after the stall instant, and all 9 unknown rows have no attempt record at or before it; a 25-row random sample of the gone population reproduced 25 of 25. The archive's cross-tabs recompute exactly (alive-no-resume 9, gone-after-resume 64, gone-no-resume 29, four gone terminal-less). The rail-env refutation is three-way durable: the watch transition at 2026-09-22T14:32:30Z from working with detail stream quiet for 902s, resume-1.jsonl present on disk, and the ledger row at attempt 2 with attempt_kind resume and completed_at 15:21:08.915Z from terminal_event. The nova refutation holds too: 98 nova manifests from 2026-09-22, 17 outside complete/blocked/failed and all of them in-reader-vocabulary words, with the two invented spellings belonging to imas-efit and surviving only in their as-delivered copies. Two figures in the delivered prose are unsupported by the artifact they cite, which the findings below name.
justifications.fit: the deliverable takes the shape the repository asks for: an evidence record under docs/evidence/archive with a live figure under docs/figures embedded from the project-absolute path, a landed section in the plan pointing at the evidence anchor, a conventional commit subject and a body stating what changed and why, no attribution and no plan or ticket identifiers in paths, symbols or comments, and the census reading its constants from source rather than restating them.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every split section 5 names is present with its denominator — process liveness (97 gone, 12 alive, 9 reported unknown rather than guessed), later outcome (41 with no resume, 73 after a resume, 3 other, 1 none), role, backend, and the stall window with its value and source; the manifest count is grouped by the word written with each group's terminal-transition status. The controls clause is not met literally, and the census says so instead of bending the instrument to the plan's wording, which is the correct handling of a control whose claim the records contradict.
justifications.scope_discipline: the commit changes four paths, every one of them declared, with no source, test or configuration file touched, the plan's state meta lines left to the coordinator, an inserts-only diffstat, and a clean worktree at head.
